author: einrikr
text:
Quite random maybe but I just had this quick thought...

Isn't it so that since Highs and Lows are usually reactions to Flag
Limits, RS-flips keep on occuring on basically the same level, over and
over? It seems to me that they keep on flipping away. And I say
basically, because of the kinks of course. They'll shift slightly in
height.

And, because of the nature of RS-flips, aren't they really tradeable with quite high RR?

I started focussing on one pair and one pair only so that I don't keep
switching between pairs that I haven't completely analyzed yet. I tend
to do this when confused, or unsure of what I'm doing. Rather than
figuring out why I'm unsure about something, I try to find what I'm
looking for in other charts. That costs quite some time and isn't useful
 at all, so I'm drawing everything I know and see in one pair: AUDUSD.
It's the first pair I've worked with, and I'm going to master it. Focus
focus focus, and when I've got it all set up, I'll add pairs along the
way.

Anyway, long story short: I saw a lot of Highs and Lows lining up over
the complete width of this pair. While marking them, I saw that the RS I
 accidentally marked and looked in to a bit more, was quite attracting
for price and gave quite high RR's. Now, I'm not sure wether this is a
"thing" or not or that I'm just seeing things...

I'll dive in this a bit further and try to do some demo trades. I like this stuff!

author: einrikr
text:
Hi Hugo,

Thanks for joining here! And thanks for your contribution, they're always welcome!

I haven't been able to reach RTM all day, so I only just read your post...

Anyway, here's where my drawings are at the moment:

And this for me is the reason for the FL that kept price up, where your FL showed some space between it and price.

Now, I have to stress that this is just in demo and it is because I'm
fully focussed at RS levels, RS-flip zones and the marking of them for
now, just to find out which ones work, which ones have good returns and
others have not, why this is, and all that.

To be honest, I have been looking at the LFL you've drawn (blue dotted
box) but I decided to drop it because it was a bit too vague for me.
Most of the FL's you see in my drawings are at RS swap zones and are
follow-ups of each other but they're working really well. I'm not at all
 confident that I've got everything figured out yet but it seems like a
nice setup and concept and the results seem really nice...

As for your drawings, I do think that the places you're looking for
shorts are really good places. They seem to have it all and I think
price is getting ready to get to those points within the next week. Some
 important levels are being engulfed as we speak, so I think it makes
great sense to look for trades there.

Please do note that I consider myself a noob in all of trading. I feel
like some different parts of RTM are clearer and clearer to me but I'm
still rather unable to read the whole story ;-)

author: Rinehart
text:
Make sure a copy of the file is in your experts folder for your
correct instance of MT4 (I run more than 1 copy of MT4 for example).
Close and reload MT4 to recompile. Find expert and drag onto your
chart. Make sure you allow auto trading and allow live trading.
